reaction: Claisen rearrangement, allyl vinyl ether to pent-4-enal

stage1.initializer_note: A linear initial path puts O on C4 and the band stays near 220 eV. IDPP uses the endpoint atom order.

stage2.construction: four linearly interpolated images in the interval before the highest image and four in the interval after it
stage2.why: On 16 images the barrier sits between two images, so the climbing image is not stationary. LBFGS with a 0.05 A cap reaches a max-atom force near 0.06 eV/A and then a 0.02 A step throws the force above 1 eV/A. A 0.008 A cap on the 24-image path stays on that shoulder.

endpoints.band_uses_permutation_from: Baker geometries, not the minimised geometries

unminimised.note: OCI-NEB on the Baker geometries, endpoints not minimised, 16 images, 500 iterations.

nonstationary_unminimised_ci.explanation: The highest image is not a stationary point. Its parallel force is almost the whole NEB force, so the image still sits on the slope. The next image is already in the product well, 0.85 eV lower, one angstrom further along the band. The discrete maximum is the shoulder before the barrier, which is why its Hessian has no mode below -50 cm^-1.
